name: lever calf raise (bench press machine)
description: A calf raise done on a chest press style lever machine, using the seat and handles to load the calves.
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the balls of your feet on the lower platform or press plate.
Push to straighten your legs and release the safety.
Lower your heels as far as is comfortable.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause at the top and lower under control.
